models.notes: ModernBERT-large backbone, 512-token context. English text, guardrails, email triage. Checkpoint at the hub repo root; laya.load('convaiinnovations/laya').
mmBERT-base backbone, 1024-token context (up to 8192 with max_len=8192). 100+ languages, ~2.2x faster than the English checkpoint. laya.load('convaiinnovations/laya', subfolder='multilingual').

ModernBERT-large backbone, 1024-token context. Fine-tuned for the typed-decisions workflows (invoice processing, security incidents, customer service, agent-trace observability). laya.load('convaiinnovations/laya', subfolder='typed-decisions').

SmolVLM-256M backbone cut to 20 language layers, ~41 ms/image. download_bytes is the measured snapshot size (whole repo at revision main, all files); fetch records exact sizes in models.lock.json. The laya-vision fork installs its own 'laya' package (cannot coexist with PyPI laya) and needs torchvision and transformers>=5.3: use per-package envs.
Previous laya-vision checkpoint (no game training), kept for comparison. Same runtime as laya-vision. download_bytes is an estimate (F32 weights).
Free-form entry: any Hugging Face repo id. The user supplies the repo, modality, loader and package_source; license is unknown until the user declares it.
